Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 Out! The Indian Airforce has officially released the Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 for the Intake 02/2026 cycle on 6th November 2025 at the official website agnipathvayu.cdac.in. The online examination was conducted on 25th September 2025 to recruit unmarried male and female candidates for the Agniveer Vayu post. Candidates who appeared in the exam can now log in using their username and password to check their qualifying status. The shortlisted candidates will proceed to the next stages of selection, which include Document Verification, Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Test, and Medical Examination. The release of the result marks the beginning of the next phase in the Indian Air Force Agniveer recruitment process, ensuring only the most capable and deserving candidates move forward.

Indian Air Force Agniveer Result 2025 Out

The Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 has been officially declared for the Intake 02/2026 cycle. The online examination was conducted on 25th September 2025, with nearly 2 lakh candidates appearing across various centres in India. Out of these applicants, around 10,000 to 20,000 candidates have been shortlisted for the next phase of the selection process. Candidates can now check their results and proceed to the upcoming stages as notified by the Indian Air Force.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 Download Link

The Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 for Intake 02/2026 is now active on the official website agnipathvayu.cdac.in. Candidates who appeared for the online examination conducted on 25th September 2025 can check their results by logging in with their Username or Email ID, Password, and Captcha code as shown on the portal. Once logged in, candidates can view their selection status and download the scorecard for future reference.

Direct Link to Download Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025

How to Download Agnipath Vayu Result 2025?

The Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2026 result has been released on 6th November 2025 and is available on the official portal agnipathvayu.cdac.in. Candidates who appeared in the online exam held can log in to view and download their result/scorecard.

Step 1: Open the official Agniveer Vayu portal (agnipathvayu.cdac.in) in your browser.

Step 2: Click on the Candidate Login / Sign In link (usually labelled “Candidate Login” or “AVREG”).

Step 3: Enter your Username or Email ID, Password and the Captcha exactly as shown on the page, then click Sign In.

Step 4: On your dashboard look for a “Result”, “Scorecard” or “Download Result” link for Intake 02/2026 and click it.

Step 5: The result/scorecard will appear on screen — check your details (name, roll/registration no., qualifying status and marks).

Step 6: Click the download / PDF icon to save a copy to your device and print at least two hard copies for future stages.

Details Mentioned on Agniveer Vayu Result 2025

The IAF Agniveer Vayu Result 2025 contains all essential information related to the candidate’s performance and qualification status. Candidates must carefully verify the details mentioned on their scorecard to ensure accuracy before proceeding to the next stages.

  • Candidate’s Name
    • Roll Number and Registration Number
    • Examination Name (Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2026)
    • Date of Birth
    • Category (General/SC/ST/OBC)
    • Marks Obtained and Qualifying Status
    • Cut-Off Marks
    • Examination Date
    • Instructions for Next Stage (Document Verification, PFT, Adaptability, and Medical Tests)

What If I forget my Indian Air Force Agniveer Exam Username and Password?

If you forget your Agnipath Vayu Exam Username or Password, you can easily recover them through the official portal agnipathvayu.cdac.in. The login page provides dedicated options for password recovery and technical assistance. Follow the steps below to regain access to your account and check your result.

Step 1: Visit the official website agnipathvayu.cdac.in.

Step 2: Click on the ‘Forgot Password?’ link on the login page.

Step 3: Enter your registered Email ID or Mobile Number.

Step 4: Follow the link sent to your email/SMS to reset your password.

Step 5: If you still face issues, click on ‘Help & Support’ for further assistance.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Exam Pattern 2025

The Airforce Agniveer Exam Pattern outlines the structure of the computer-based test (CBT) conducted for different educational backgrounds. The exam assesses candidates’ knowledge in subjects like English, Mathematics, Physics, and Reasoning. The marking scheme includes one mark for each correct answer and a deduction of 0.25 marks for every wrong response.

  • The exam is conducted online in multiple shifts across India.
    • The paper pattern differs for Science and Other than Science streams.
    • Candidates must complete the test within the prescribed time limit.

What’s Next After the Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025?

After the declaration of the IAF Agnipath Vayu Result 2025, candidates who have qualified in the online examination must appear for the next stages of the selection process. These stages include Document Verification (DV) and the Physical Fitness Test (PFT), followed by Adaptability Tests and a Medical Examination. Each stage is crucial to ensure candidates meet all eligibility and physical standards required for Airforce service.

Document Verification

The DV stage for the Indian Air Force “Agniveer Vayu” selection ensures that all claimed credentials and background information are genuine and verifiable.

  • Original Class 10 mark sheet/certificate to verify name, father’s name, and date of birth.
  • Original Class 12 (or equivalent) mark sheet/certificate or Diploma/ITI certificate if applicable, along with four self-attested photocopies.
  • Aadhaar card (or any valid government photo ID), domicile certificate if required, and eight recent passport-size colour photographs (used during application).
  • Downloaded colour print-out of the online application form along with admit card/phase-I hall ticket bearing Air Force seal and invigilator’s signature.
  • Other documents (if applicable) like SOAFP certificate (Son of Air Force Personnel), NCC certificate ‘A/B/C’, etc., as per notification.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT)

The PFT stage evaluates the candidate’s physical endurance, strength and agility as required for the Agniveer Vayu role.

  • 1.6 km run to be completed within 6 minutes 30 seconds (for general standard) to test cardiovascular fitness.
  • Minimum of 10 push-ups, 10 sit-ups, and 20 squats in one minute each (or as per test rules) to assess muscular strength/endurance.
  • Height requirement: minimum 152.5 cm for male candidates (female standard often similar or as per notification) and chest expansion (male) at least 5 cm.
  • Weight must be proportionate to height and age; footwear (sports shoes) and correct attire must be used; no change of centre permitted.

Adaptability Test-I

The Adaptability Test-I stage assesses how well candidates can handle operational scenarios in the Air Force environment.

  • Objective-type questions based on deployment into varied terrains, weather conditions and operational shifts.
  • It measures reaction to situations, problem-solving under stress, and mental preparedness for the Agniveer Vayu tenure.

Adaptability Test-II

The Adaptability Test-II stage evaluates the candidate’s fit for the day-to-day life of the Indian Air Force and teamwork under discipline.

  • Group discussion or task-based assessment focusing on teamwork, communication, and adaptation to military lifestyle and training regime.
  • Candidates may face scenario-based simulations or interaction to test attitude, behaviour, and ability to adjust to Air Force routines.

Medical Examination

The final stage is a comprehensive medical examination to confirm the candidate’s fitness and medical eligibility for induction as Agniveer Vayu.

  • Height: Minimum 152.5 cm (male) / approx. similar for female; Chest expansion (male) minimum 5 cm.
  • Vision: Uncorrected minimum 6/6 in one eye and 6/9 in the other; colour vision normal; corrective surgery such as LASIK/PRK may be disqualifying.
  • Hearing: Candidate must be able to hear a forced whisper from a distance of 6 metres in each ear separately.
  • Additional investigations: Blood haemogram (Hb, TLC, DLC), urine RE/ME, biochemistry (blood sugar, cholesterol), chest X-ray, ECG, tests for substance abuse, and any other tests as per medical board.
  • No evidence of hernia, flat feet, physical deformity, chronic disease, or skin infection; weight must be proportionate, no recent refractive surgery if disallowed.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. When was the Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 released?
A1. The Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025 for Intake 02/2026 was officially released on 6th November 2025 on the official website agnipathvayu.cdac.in.

Q2. How can I download the Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Result 2025?
A2. To download the IAF Agniveer Result 2025, visit agnipathvayu.cdac.in, log in using your Username or Email ID and Password, and click on the “Download Result” link available for Intake 02/2026.

Q3. What are the next stages after the Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025?
A3. Candidates shortlisted in the Agniveer Vayu Result 2025 must appear for Document Verification (DV), Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Tests, and the Medical Examination.

Q4. What should I do if I forget my Agniveer Vayu Exam Username or Password?
A4. If you forget your Indian Airforce Exam Username or Password, click on the ‘Forgot Password?’ link on the login page of agnipathvayu.cdac.in and follow the steps to reset it.

Q5. How many candidates were shortlisted in the Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2025?
A5. Out of nearly 2 lakh candidates who appeared in the Agniveer Vayu Exam 2025 held on 25th September 2025, around 10,000 to 20,000 candidates have been shortlisted for the next phase.
